title: ReplayResult
description: Level 2 Historical Replay Engine milestone: one market-row comparison (original production decision vs replayed decision) belonging to a ReplayRun. Research-only. See docs/REPLAY_ENGINE.md.

marketFamily.description: Derived from marketTicker when one exists; legitimately null (not a defect) when marketTicker itself is null -- deliberately absent from required for the same reason snapshot_component.schema.json's storageMode is not required: lib.edgelab.schema's shallow validator treats any required-but-None field as a validation error, and null is the honest value here, not a missing one.

selection.description: The production market name, e.g. 'F5_ML_Away', 'ML_Home', 'NRFI' -- copied verbatim from the marketLedger row.

threshold.description: The market's line/threshold, when one exists.

originalMarketPrice.description: kalshiVF -- the vig-free MIDPOINT-based market-implied probability, copied verbatim from the original row. NOT the executable price that actually determined edge/recommendation (edgeUsedForQualification is calibratedEdgeVsExecutable) -- see originalExecutablePriceUsed/originalExecutableMarketProb for that. Retained for display parity with the original production artifact; replay never recomputes a historical market price.

replayedMarketPrice.description: kalshiVF from the replayed row -- same midpoint caveat as originalMarketPrice.

originalExecutablePriceUsed.description: The ORIGINAL row's executablePriceUsed (yes_ask/no_ask, cents 0-100) -- the exact executable price production's own qualification math used, copied verbatim, never a later registry snapshot/closing price/last trade/reconstructed complement. Null when the original row never had a real ask (see scripts/build_market_ledger.py:executable_ask_price_cents's documented American-odds-implied fallback, applied identically to both original and replayed sides since both are the same function over frozen odds).

replayedExecutablePriceUsed.description: The REPLAYED row's executablePriceUsed, recomputed by re-running evaluate_game() against the frozen NORMALIZED_SLATE odds -- same source data the original used, never a live/current price feed.

originalExecutableMarketProb.description: Probability-scale (0-100) equivalent of originalExecutablePriceUsed -- the price actually compared against modelProb for calibratedEdgeVsExecutable, i.e. the field that actually gated the original recommendation.

originalRecommendationStatus.description: e.g. Accepted, Rejected, Missing Data -- copied verbatim from the frozen RECOMMENDATION_OUTPUT row.

originalTier.description: e.g. HIGH, MEDIUM, PAPER -- from the frozen RISK_GATE_OUTPUT candidate, when comparable.

originalPreferredExpression.description: Not populated in this milestone -- market_comparison.py's expression-preference concept is a separate, not-yet-wired research engine; always null, never fabricated.

comparisonClassification.description: See lib/edgelab/replay.py:classify_comparison's exact decision table. A changed decision is never itself interpreted as an improvement (see docs/REPLAY_ENGINE.md) -- this field is descriptive only.

settlementLinkage.description: Joined from the linked POST_GAME_SETTLEMENT snapshot's frozen SETTLEMENT component by marketTicker, when one exists and verifies -- never re-derived from raw scores here (lib.edgelab.settlement already did that). status=UNRESOLVED (with a reason) when no such snapshot/record exists, never a fabricated result.

clvLinkage.description: Joined from the linked POST_GAME_SETTLEMENT snapshot's frozen CLV component by marketTicker.

comparisonMetadata.description: Free-form but small: anything else useful to a human auditing this one row (e.g. lineupConfirmationState, checkpoint). Never a place for fabricated fields.
